tool: Existing Playwright1.62.1; Browser plugin not available
flow: login -> explicit mode change/confirmation -> save -> native Storage readback -> reload restores only UserMode -> actual original request

checks.name: desktop identity, meaningful first screen, no overlay and no automatic preference write
mode confirmation locks save and fields; Escape cancellation preserves current inputs
confirmed mode change clears inputs and initializes flags without an automatic write
explicit save stores only mode; reload restores mode but resets inputs, encoding, checkbox choices and consent
actual original request after restore retains owned mode; locked synthetic actions cannot save or alter it
switching back to clear mode invalidates candidates and is persisted only by explicit save
future/invalid record is preserved on read and replaced only by an explicit save
unavailable native storage leaves configuration and input flow usable, with controlled status
quota exception remains unconfirmed, preserves current inputs and never echoes provider details
competing native readback is reported unconfirmed and never rolled back automatically
completed write plus failed verification stays unconfirmed; next load reads the actual saved mode
390px actual save/reload/restore has readable controls and no horizontal overflow

scope: Native Storage positive paths. Only failure/readback negative fixtures use controlled method hooks; all calls otherwise delegate to real browser Storage. Actual original Python peer for one request, no original EXE/VM/official service or real accounts.
